Name: SeasonalBridge
Author: coola101
Description:
A small tilesheet replacer replacing a few tiles from the "winter_island_tilesheet_1" which appear as though they are in summer.

I made this mod for the purposes of my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23171/]Eight Slices[/url] farm map mod, which incorporated the original asset, finding that it does not have a proper winter appearance. Upon further investigation (thanks to a helpful Post made to the mod), I found that the bridge isn't 100% appropriately adapted to Fall or Spring. Consequently, I chose to similarly modify the tilesets for the other seasons to bring them in line with their seasonal variations.

This mod does not modify the bridge used on the Island, but only its unimplemented seasonal variants. The tilesheet the bridge is on is similarly used on the Beach Farm, and so is supposed to change with the seasons; however, the Island in-game is locked to the Summer variant, and will never update.

Downloads.Description: Small mod which implements seasonal variations of the suspension bridge in the [season]_island_tilesheet_1 tilesheets for spring, fall, and winter.
